content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Food At Disneyland's PostFood At DisneylandOctober 8, 2025 · Shared with PublicHere is a look at the updated Disneyland price points for standard one park per day. Disneyland Single Day Ticket Prices:Tier 0 - $104 (+$0)Tier 1 - $129 (+$3)Tier 2 - $149 (+$7)Tier 3 - $169 (+$5)Tier 4 - $184 (+$4)Tier 5 - $199 (+$3)Tier 6 - $224 (+$18)A park hopper ticket add-on will now add $70-$90 to the price point depending on the tier level for that day. As an example, a Tier 7 park hopper will add $90 which brings that single day price point to $314 per ticket.
